TechCorp Solutions Pvt. Ltd. Compliance Documentation

Board Meeting Minutes:
- Regular quarterly board meetings conducted with proper quorum maintained
- Annual General Meeting held on September 15, 2024 within statutory timelines  
- Directors present included Independent Directors and Executive Directors
- All resolutions properly passed for statutory compliance matters
- Meeting minutes properly recorded, signed and maintained in statutory books

Financial Compliance and Statements:
- Annual Financial Statements prepared and audited by qualified chartered accountant  
- Comprehensive financial statements include Balance Sheet, Profit & Loss Statement, and Cash Flow Statement
- Board's report includes all mandatory disclosures as per Companies Act requirements
- Auditor's report shows unqualified opinion with no adverse comments
- Financial statements prepared as per Schedule III format and accounting standards
- Notes to accounts properly prepared with all material information disclosed
- AOC-4 form filing completed within statutory deadline after AGM

Annual Return and Regulatory Filings:
- Form MGT-7 Annual Return filed with Registrar of Companies with updated shareholding details
- Register of Members maintained and updated regularly with latest shareholding pattern
- All director details updated in MCA records through proper filing procedures
- Registered office address confirmed and updated in official records
- ROC filings completed within prescribed timelines without any delays

Director and Key Personnel Compliance:
- All directors have valid DIN numbers and are actively participating in board meetings
- DIR-3 KYC forms filed for all directors annually within prescribed deadlines
- Independent director declarations obtained and filed with proper attestations
- Director appointment and resignation procedures followed as per statutory requirements
- Key Managerial Personnel including Company Secretary and CFO properly appointed
- Managing Director appointed with proper board resolution and consent obtained

Corporate Governance and Internal Controls:
- Board committees constituted as per statutory requirements with proper composition
- Audit committee meetings held regularly with independent director participation
- Internal controls and risk management framework implemented and reviewed periodically
- Related party transactions properly approved by audit committee and disclosed
- Corporate governance policies implemented and regularly monitored for compliance

Statutory Books and Records Maintenance:
- Register of Directors properly maintained with current information
- Register of Charges updated with all security interests properly recorded  
- Minutes books for board meetings and general meetings properly maintained
- All statutory registers are up to date and available for inspection
- Compliance calendar maintained to track all regulatory obligations

Auditor Appointment and Compliance:
- Statutory auditor appointed by board resolution within prescribed timelines
- Auditor eligibility and independence verified before appointment
- Form ADT-1 filed for auditor appointment within statutory deadlines  
- Auditor remuneration fixed by board and shareholders as required
- Auditor consent letter obtained and filed with registrar

This comprehensive compliance documentation demonstrates TechCorp Solutions' commitment to maintaining full compliance with Indian Companies Act 2013 requirements and MCA regulations.
